dropped_claim: BAML's function-calling post cites this paper to argue schema constraints degrade quality. The abstract reports a decline in reasoning under stricter format restrictions. The effect is contested: dottxt re-ran three of its tasks on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and found structured generation equal or better, blaming unequal prompts between conditions, a JSON prompt that never mentioned JSON, and an LLM answer parser. The effect seems to depend on prompt parity and parser choice, so neither side is settled evidence for forced tool calls on Claude.
